originality.rationale: Directed searches compared the precise radial zero measure, its Stieltjes/M-series aliases, stronger convergence formulas, and known multiple-orthogonal star laws. The 2026 general convergence theorem is used as a premise; the complete exact phase profile requires and receives separate nontrivial algebraic-branch, atom and edge analysis. The 2023 treatment excludes the repeated-critical degree>=3 case. Classical Angelesco laws inspected have different defining polynomial objects and boundary exponents. No matching prior result was identified, with explicit residual historical risks. The root-atom mass and its disappearance follow from Proposition 3.4 of the 2026 source and are not asserted as independently original.
